name: Shear-Warp Factorization Volume Rendering
definition: An object-order rendering algorithm that factors the viewing transformation into a 3D shear, a projection, and a 2D warp to exploit spatial coherence.
summary: Shear-Warp Factorization Volume Rendering is a fast, scanline-based algorithm that reduces 3D ray casting to two 2D resampling operations by shearing volume slices to align viewing rays with a coordinate axis.
